name: DocuHog Local DocuSign API Mock
free_limit: MIT-licensed local mock DocuSign eSignature REST API server with mock OAuth, envelope and template endpoints, status simulation, web UI and Docker/Node.js deployment; no software usage quota stated.
watch_out: For development and CI simulation only: no actual signing ceremony or real DocuSign delivery. Own compute/storage required; optional SMTP delivery uses an external mail server. Docker data is ephemeral without a mounted volume.
